units.time: Unix epoch milliseconds; durations in milliseconds
units.position: World pixels (16 pixels per tile), not screen pixels
units.zone: zona announces the latest committed construction revision for the current scene, including scenes without pushable props. Changed revisions only, at most once per second (2500 ms for spectators); fetch the authenticated community snapshot through HTTP. Repeated notifications coalesce; no construction DTOs or account data on this channel.
units.crossing: cruzar: monotonic request ID, kind door|edge|dock, authored connection id, from [x,y,direction], destination scene/position/mode. cruce acknowledges or rejects atomically. No movement across modes/scenes without a valid authored transition.
units.viewport: [left, top, width, height] in world pixels; clipped to scene bounds
units.people: [publicId, x, y, directionIndex, poseIndex, variant, mode] per visible player; mode 0=foot, 1=boat; excludes the viewer
units.push: empujo carries a scene, authored shared object ID and cardinal direction (up|down|left|right), never positions or strength. object=null and direction=null stop pushing. Renew while touching, at most 20 Hz; intent expires after 200 ms.
units.objects: Full relevant shared-object snapshot: [objectId, x, y, revision]. Relevant means viewport OR within objectReachPixels of an admitted player (for collision with a panned camera); spectators receive only viewport. Sent only when changed, up to 20 Hz for players and every 2500 ms for spectators. Missing IDs leave interest, not the persistent world.
